Class AppUtils

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.utils.AppUtils
public class AppUtils extends Object
Shared utility methods used across the web edition.

Contains:

  • Time and duration formatting helpers
  • Structured error logging

The desktop edition of this class also held JavaFX window-size constants, dialog builders and an album-art ImageView builder. Those have no server-side equivalent: sizing is handled by CSS, dialogs by the shared modal helper in static/js/app.js, and album art by the /media/art/album/{id} endpoint.

      public static String formatRelativeTime(LocalDateTime time)
      Formats a timestamp relative to now, e.g. "5m ago" or "Yesterday".

      Time Complexity: O(1)

      Parameters:
      time - the timestamp to describe; may be null
      Returns:
      a short relative-time label, or an empty string when time is null
